data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Teton Advisors' most recent 13F for June 30, 2026 shows positions in TRC and LMNR.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier (+71.7% y/y). (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm)

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service based solely on public records. May I send the free weekly issue and details on a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
